sn37.33:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāram ajjhāvasati ||
sn37.33:1.3: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato ca hoti || adinnādānā paṭivirato ca hoti || kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato ca hoti || musāvādā paṭivirato ca hoti || surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato ca hoti || || 4
sn37.33:1.4: Imehi kho pana bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāram ajjhāvasatī
